name: Chushan Rishathaim
overview: Chushan Rishathaim, identified as the king of Mesopotamia, is depicted in Judges 3 as the oppressor whom God allowed to rule over Israel for eight years due to Israel's disobedience. The Lord's anger led to Israel being delivered into his hand, but when Israel cried out in repentance, God raised up Othniel as a deliverer empowered by His Spirit to defeat Chushan Rishathaim and bring relief to His people. This account highlights God's sovereign discipline and mercy, emphasizing His faithfulness to rescue His people through appointed deliverers.
